effect:
Extends duration of trapping moves.

Grip Claw extends the duration of moves like Wrap, Bind, Fire Spin, and Whirlpool from their normal duration to the maximum 7 turns! More turns means more residual damage.

This is useful for trapping moves where you want to chip down the opponent while they're stuck in. Combine with trapping abilities and it can cause significant damage with the trap!
